issue.title: dropdown to the Trigger DAG has dramatically decrease UX
issue.body:
### Description

Hi, the new dropdown which appears on clicking Trigger button has dramatically decreased user experience. I understand, many people need the ability to trigger with same parameters, but it should not cost for others. We trigger same DAG 8 times and select then a country parameter in popup, now i must do the additional mouse move and click to choose "Trigger" in new popup.

I have found the feature request https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/69820

### Use case/motivation

I would like you to create instead of popup one of the options:
a) another button "Trigger again with this config" left to the existing button "Trigger". Left because everyone has used to normal "Trigger" is the **most right** button, breaking it will be very bad.
b) transform "Trigger" button to the same style as you can see now in github top the "Chat with copilot" button. So click on the left "main" part of the button call action by default (=normal trigger), and click on right "select" part with triangle shows popup with the option " trigger with same parameters"

### Related issues

https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/69820 

### Are you willing to submit a PR?

- [ ] Yes I am willing to submit a PR!

### Code of Conduct

- [x] I agree to follow this project's [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)

comments.body: @vgl-grin - which version of Airflow are you using?

I'd like to take this on. Based on #69820 and this issue, it sounds like a split-button pattern (default action + small dropdown affordance, similar to GitHub's Merge button) is the preferred direction over the current click-to-open-menu-then-click-Trigger flow. Before I open a PR: should this reuse the shared button abstraction from #45097 (TriggerDAGButton/ClearRunButton), and should 'remember last config' apply only within a session, or persist per-user? Happy to start once I have a nod on approach

Opened a draft PR implementing this: https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73564

Approach taken: split-button pattern (option (b)) — the main part of the button always triggers by default in one click, and an always-visible caret next to it opens a small menu with "Trigger with config" and, when the currently selected run carried a config, "Trigger again with this config". Both parts are disabled together when manual runs aren't allowed; existing variant/withText call sites are unchanged.

Kept it as a draft pending a nod on the always-visible caret direction (vs. the narrower "caret only when a config'd run is selected" variant from #69820/#45097). Happy to iterate on the design or the #70413 overlap once reviewed.
